ValidationRule.description: Validate order totals, discounts, shipping charges and shipping address
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( Grand_Total__c < 0, Discount_Amount__c < 0, Shipping_Charges__c < 0, AND( ISPICKVAL(Order_Status__c, "Confirmed"), ISBLANK(Shipping_Address__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Order amounts cannot be negative, and confirmed orders must have a shipping address.
